title: Spec 014 Tenant Canary Canonical Structured Evidence

phases.objective: Upgrade the existing Tenant Canary Guard to publish one exact-head, secret-free canonical JSON/Markdown artifact while retaining and pre-integration testing all synthetic, provenance, not-before, ordering, and regression coverage.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec 014 reviewer and repository evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The fixed-command Tenant Canary canonical runner and the upgraded Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact PR head executes all eight guard checks under E2E governance now, and after Integration activation the same runner writes a run-bound canonical report with bounded diagnostics and an enforceable pass/fail decision without reconstructing status from Job logs.
steps: Validate the producer/report contract and workflow safety boundary.
Execute the canonical Tenant Canary runner directly under E2E governance on the exact PR head.
Run deterministic dependency installation, syntax, synthetic boundary, Base import, runtime provenance, policy not-before, pre-consumption ordering, and the complete Tenant canary regression suite.
Redact and bound stdout/stderr tails before storing structured results.
Write mad4b.hostinger-guard-summary.v1 JSON and Markdown before returning the guard result.
After this workflow definition reaches Integration, upload both files with if:always under a run-bound artifact name.
Validate exact SHA, counts, results, first failure, integrity findings, no-secret declaration, no-log decision, and no-mutation/provider/credential declarations before enforcing the outcome.
assertions: The workflow remains named Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard.
The report workflow and guard_key identify Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard and hostinger-storage-tenant-canary.
The candidate kind is head and candidate SHA equals the exact pull-request head.
All eight fixed checks execute successfully under the current E2E journey before Integration activation.
A passed report has eight passes, zero failures, zero integrity findings, and first_failure=null.
A failed report identifies the first failed check and includes only bounded redacted diagnostics.
The workflow retains contents:read and receives no issue, pull-request, or repository write authority.
The workflow has no workflow_dispatch, git push, force push, provider call, Hostinger/SSH access, credential access, SQL, migration, deployment, or Production mutation.
repository_mutation_performed, provider_dispatch_performed, credential_access_performed, job_logs_consulted, and secrets_included remain false.
Automatic Artifact publication requires this upgraded workflow to reach the Integration base, and trusted PR-comment publication additionally requires Parent PR #4540 to reach main.

phases.objective: Publish and consume the first run-bound Tenant Canary canonical Artifact through the trusted main-based publisher.
blockers: The upgraded Tenant Canary Guard must first reach the Spec 014 Integration base so subsequent pull requests execute the new Artifact-producing definition.
Parent PR #4540 must reach main before the trusted workflow_run publisher can consume the Artifact and update the authoritative PR comment.

phases.objective: Exercise dependency-install failure, malformed report output, artifact absence, stale remote head, cancelled runs, and publisher retry behavior while preserving canonical-first diagnosis.
The change reports a synthetic CI guard and does not execute a live Hostinger canary.
The change grants no provider dispatch, deployment, migration, Production promotion, or Production mutation authority.
